news.title: FIFA U15 World Cup Requires More Attention, Says Grassroots Sport Forum President Godwin Bamigboye
news.lede: The president of Nigerian Grassroots Sport Development Forum (NGSDF), Godwin Bamigboye has charged the country’s decision makers in football to give better attention to preparations for the forthcoming FIFA U-15 World Cup. Sports247 reports that, with the cadet championship and festival scheduled to hold in Azerbaijan from the 24th to 30th of next month, Bamigboye is worried that Nigeria has not set preparations in motion; and warned that such levity could adversely affect the country’s team. Bamigboye went on to urge top shots at Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) and National Sports Commission (NSC) to immediately commence full fledged action, in order to ensure the country’s team, Baby Eagles, get a good outing in the championship.

news.title: A ridiculous Spain XI missing Barcelona players could still win the World Cup
news.lede: You know your country produces serious talent when you could field an XI missing all players from the league champions and still probably be the favourite to win the World Cup. That is the premise come up with by FotMob who posted to their social media a line up of the Spanish national team missing all of the Barcelona players and it is no surprise that it is still brilliant. Four Barcelona players have been omitted under the new rules and the most notable drop in quality comes over on the right wing. New Liverpool signing Victor Munoz is very talented but he unfortunately has the very large shoes of Lamine Yamal to fill.

news.title: Lamine Yamal: ‘Football is mechanised but players like me have that special spark’
news.lede: Spain and Barcelona wonderkid has won World Cup and European Championship but says there are no limits for his career. Like the kid he is, Lamine Yamal just wanted to keep playing. This wasn’t Plaça Joan XXIII, wasn’t El Parque de Rocafonda either; it wasn’t the Mataró neighbourhood where it all began, but it might have been. “We’re in a World Cup final and I wanted to carry on,” he says, and there’s the smile again, the braces.

news.lede: AP AP Photo/Abbie Parr https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/xs3dng/article71511678.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/US_Pochettino_Soccer_62632.jpg ABBIE PARR FILE - United States head coach Mauricio Pochettino walks off the field after the United States lost a World Cup round of 16 soccer match against Belgium in Seattle, July 6, 2026. (AP Photo/Abbie Parr, File) Balogun — who was USA’s leading goal-scorer in the tournament — had a dismissal against Bosnia and Herzegovina overturned when US President Donald Trump spoke to FIFA leadership, allowing him to be available for its Round of 16 clash against Belgium. ORLANDO USA coach Mauricio Pochettino said he should have been more involved in the decision to appeal Folarin Balogun’s red card during the FIFA World Cup 2026.

news.title: England aim to win over Wembley and revive Wonderwall in Spain glamour fixture
news.lede: Emotions of a Nations League match cannot pulse to the same levels as the World Cup but Tuchel needs to reconnect. Thomas Tuchel has pictured the scene. It comes after the final whistle has blown on England’s Nations League opener against Spain on Saturday night, the first post-World Cup fixture for both teams, and it has Wembley swaying to the strains of Wonderwall. It is a moment of communion, a reconnection with the Oasis classic that was the soundtrack to England’s World Cup campaign, which delivered so much only to end in such disappointment.

news.title: Shock Brazil draw a sure sign Socceroos have learnt from World Cup mistakes
news.lede: The Socceroos were denied their first win over Brazil since 2001 after Rayan equalised for the Seleção with only seconds left on the clock. Socceroos coach Tony Popovic reflected on the result post-match stating that there were many positives to take from the result and performance. Nestory Irankunda celebrating his goal in the Socceroos’ friendly against Brazil. “I think it’s maybe a sign of progress if we are a bit disappointed and I think the dressing room’s a bit quiet,” Popovic said.

news.title: Kane keen to banish World Cup demons as England host Spain in Nations League
news.lede: Harry Kane says England are eager to test themselves against world champions Spain in Saturday's Nations League meeting at Wembley. Harry Kane commented on the challenge of facing Spain in the Nations League. La Roja, who defeated England to win the final of the 2024 European Championships, achieved where the Three Lions did not in beating Argentina to get their hands on the World Cup this year. Spain and England meet once more at Wembley Stadium on Saturday evening, and for the captain, it is an opportunity for the team to prove that they can continue to compete with the best for honours.
